Register Description: Sysreg interrupt enable; GPIO per-pin register; Group interrupt enable; Group interrupt status; Sysreg raw status clear
Preconditions: System reset completed; GIC IRQ 87 routable; GPIO0 block accessible at base 0xA001A000; External SRAM at 0xA0243ffc accessible; Compiled with #define GPIO0 1
Test Steps: 1. Enable GIC IRQ 87 for GPIO0 interrupt routing. 2. Enable GPIO0 interrupt in sysreg: write_reg(MIZAR_LSS_SYSREG_INTR_EN1 LSS_SYSREG_INTR_EN1_GPIO0_INTR). 3. Active-high loop (i=0..31): write_reg(MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_GPIO_8+(i*4) 0x00180000) - input mode level_sel=1; write_reg(MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_INTR1_INTR_EN1 1<<i); write_reg(0xA0243ffc 0xffffffff); Wait for ISR. 4. Active-low loop (i=0..31): write_reg(MIZAR_GPIO_GP0_GPIO_8+(i*4) 0x00100000); write_reg(0xA0243ffc ~(1<<i)); Wait for ISR. 5. ISR Handler: Verify raw status group status clear interrupt verify read-back clear group clear sysreg GIC_ClearIRQ(87). 6. finish(test_err).
Expected Result: All 64 interrupt cycles (32 active-high + 32 active-low) complete with test_err == 0
